answer: An agent marketplace requires $100 in locked collateral for each active task slot, whether the job tracks glacier melt, maps a dune, or removes an echo from audio. Splitting one agent into a thousand identities creates no extra capacity without a thousand deposits. If an agent submits a result that fails the task’s published, deterministic check, its deposit is slashed. A sybil attacker must tie up real capital for every slot and risks losing it on each invalid result.
